name: Teacher discount - 15% off Extra 2.0, 2 lines
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: warm, tired teacher.
scripted_messages: Hi! Hope your day's going better than mine, I just finished a week of parent-teacher conferences haha. I teach middle school and saw there's a 15% teacher discount on Extra 2.0. My boyfriend and I want 2 lines on Extra 2.0 with our own unlocked phones. What would the two lines cost with the discount?
no worries tyt, take ur time
Thank you! Does the 15% apply to both lines or just mine since I'm the teacher?
That makes sense. What would my first bill look like with all taxes and fees, so I'm not surprised?
Okay, that's a little more than I was hoping for the first month, but you were so kind and clear, I really appreciate it.
Nope, that's all for today! Have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
